chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, who said:
I asked him, 'Why was the Talbiyya instituted?'
So he said: 'Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to Ibrahim (peace be upon him): "Proclaim to the people the Hajj"'
"They will come to you on foot and on every lean camel, coming from every deep pass."
So he called out, and was answered from every direction, [with the people] saying 'Labbayya' (Talbiyya).

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ ( عليه السلام ): Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), peace be upon him.
key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةُ: The ritual declaration 'Labbayk Allahumma labbayk' recited by pilgrims during Hajj.
key_terms.ضَامِرٍ: Lean camel (specifically one whose flesh has sunk due to the ribs being visible, indicating long travel).

ai.seo_question: What is the theological and historical reason for reciting the Talbiyya during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi elucidates the divine origin of the Talbiyya, linking the pilgrim's response directly to the call of Ibrahim (AS) as revealed in Quran 22:27. It highlights the theological concept of 'Istijaba' (answering the call), where the physical gathering of pilgrims from all directions fulfills the prophetic proclamation, establishing the Talbiyya as a reciprocal dialogue between the Divine Command and the believer's submission.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby who said,
‘I asked himasws, ‘Why has the Talbiyya made to be?’
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto Ibrahim<sup>as</sup>
[22:27] And proclaim among the people for the Pilgrimage: they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel, coming from every remote path.
So heas called out, and was answered from every direction, exclaiming Talbiyya’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following:
“I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about why Talbiyah is required.
He (the Imam) said, ‘Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, sent revelation to Ibrahim ‘Alayhi al-Salam that said, ‘Call people for al-Hajj.
They will come to you on foot and on lean camels from all directions.’
He called and his call was answered from all directions with al-Talbiyah (here I am O Lord, to obey Your command).”’
